en.text: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西晓谕以色列各支派的首领说：「耶和华所吩咐的乃是这样：

zhTraditional.text: 摩西曉諭以色列各支派的首領說：「耶和華所吩咐的乃是這樣：

en.text: When a man vows a vow to the LORD, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 人若向耶和华许愿或起誓，要约束自己，就不可食言，必要按口中所出的一切话行。

zhTraditional.text: 人若向耶和華許願或起誓，要約束自己，就不可食言，必要按口中所出的一切話行。

en.text: “Also, when a woman vows a vow to the LORD and binds herself by a pledge, being in her father’s house, in her youth,

zhSimplified.text: 女子年幼、还在父家的时候，若向耶和华许愿，要约束自己，

zhTraditional.text: 女子年幼、還在父家的時候，若向耶和華許願，要約束自己，

en.text: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

zhSimplified.text: 她父亲也听见她所许的愿并约束自己的话，却向她默默不言，她所许的愿并约束自己的话就都要为定。

zhTraditional.text: 她父親也聽見她所許的願並約束自己的話，卻向她默默不言，她所許的願並約束自己的話就都要為定。

en.text: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. The LORD will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.

zhSimplified.text: 但她父亲听见的日子若不应承她所许的愿和约束自己的话，就都不得为定；耶和华也必赦免她，因为她父亲不应承。

zhTraditional.text: 但她父親聽見的日子若不應承她所許的願和約束自己的話，就都不得為定；耶和華也必赦免她，因為她父親不應承。

en.text: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,

zhSimplified.text: 她若出了嫁，有愿在身，或是口中出了约束自己的冒失话，

zhTraditional.text: 她若出了嫁，有願在身，或是口中出了約束自己的冒失話，

en.text: and her husband hears it, and says nothing to her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her pledges with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

zhSimplified.text: 她丈夫听见的日子，却向她默默不言，她所许的愿并约束自己的话就都要为定。

zhTraditional.text: 她丈夫聽見的日子，卻向她默默不言，她所許的願並約束自己的話就都要為定。

en.text: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. The LORD will forgive her.

zhSimplified.text: 但她丈夫听见的日子，若不应承，就算废了她所许的愿和她出口约束自己的冒失话；耶和华也必赦免她。

zhTraditional.text: 但她丈夫聽見的日子，若不應承，就算廢了她所許的願和她出口約束自己的冒失話；耶和華也必赦免她。

en.text: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.

zhSimplified.text: 寡妇或是被休的妇人所许的愿，就是她约束自己的话，都要为定。

zhTraditional.text: 寡婦或是被休的婦人所許的願，就是她約束自己的話，都要為定。

en.text: “If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

zhSimplified.text: 她若在丈夫家里许了愿或起了誓，约束自己，

zhTraditional.text: 她若在丈夫家裏許了願或起了誓，約束自己，

en.text: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.

zhSimplified.text: 丈夫听见，却向她默默不言，也没有不应承，她所许的愿并约束自己的话就都要为定。

zhTraditional.text: 丈夫聽見，卻向她默默不言，也沒有不應承，她所許的願並約束自己的話就都要為定。

en.text: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. The LORD will forgive her.

zhSimplified.text: 丈夫听见的日子，若把这两样全废了，妇人口中所许的愿或是约束自己的话就都不得为定，因她丈夫已经把这两样废了；耶和华也必赦免她。

zhTraditional.text: 丈夫聽見的日子，若把這兩樣全廢了，婦人口中所許的願或是約束自己的話就都不得為定，因她丈夫已經把這兩樣廢了；耶和華也必赦免她。

en.text: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

zhSimplified.text: 凡她所许的愿和刻苦约束自己所起的誓，她丈夫可以坚定，也可以废去。

zhTraditional.text: 凡她所許的願和刻苦約束自己所起的誓，她丈夫可以堅定，也可以廢去。

en.text: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges which are on her. He has established them, because he said nothing to her in the day that he heard them.

zhSimplified.text: 倘若她丈夫天天向她默默不言，就算是坚定她所许的愿和约束自己的话；因丈夫听见的日子向她默默不言，就使这两样坚定。

zhTraditional.text: 倘若她丈夫天天向她默默不言，就算是堅定她所許的願和約束自己的話；因丈夫聽見的日子向她默默不言，就使這兩樣堅定。

en.text: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”

zhSimplified.text: 但她丈夫听见以后，若使这两样全废了，就要担当妇人的罪孽。」

zhTraditional.text: 但她丈夫聽見以後，若使這兩樣全廢了，就要擔當婦人的罪孽。」

en.text: These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.

zhSimplified.text: 这是丈夫待妻子，父亲待女儿，女儿年幼、还在父家，耶和华所吩咐摩西的律例。

zhTraditional.text: 這是丈夫待妻子，父親待女兒，女兒年幼、還在父家，耶和華所吩咐摩西的律例。
